faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most common questions
faq.q1: How long does it take for the team to respond?
faq.a1: Our team responds in less than 24 hours on business days. For urgent support, contact us by phone or live chat.
faq.q2: Can I schedule a call with an advisor?
faq.a2: Yes, Pro and Elite plan users have access to scheduled video calls. Free users can request calls based on availability.
faq.q3: Do you offer support in other languages?
faq.a3: We currently offer support in Spanish and English. We will be adding more languages soon.
